core_principles.SW-01_story_and_suffering_truth: Every historical war shot honours the physical reality of the men in the line: freezing cold, mud, exhaustion, and the gulf between distant rulers or commanders and the soldiers bearing the cost.
core_principles.SW-02_free_descriptive_brief: Write each shot's director_brief in natural, expressive prose—never closed enum codes or numeric effect budgets—stating mood, viewer_feeling, physical_truth, focal_priority, sound_perspective, and restraint_note.
core_principles.SW-03_brief_serves_actual_narration: Anchor every brief to the shot's actual spoken audio_lines text and delivery_direction.
core_principles.SW-04_authored_vs_approved_staging: Preserve original authored staging in authored_intent_archive whenever approved visual staging in start_01.png adapts a non-spoken prop or background detail; if a painting contradicts a noun or action spoken in audio_lines, flag it to regeneration_queue.json.
core_principles.SW-05_sequential_emotional_continuity: Review briefs as a continuous sequence so consecutive shots build emotional momentum without jarring tonal resets.

brief_contract_fields.mood: Free-form description of the emotional and atmospheric register of the shot.
brief_contract_fields.viewer_feeling: What the audience must experience emotionally during this spoken line.
brief_contract_fields.physical_truth: Concrete weather, light, temperature, enclosure, and material reality of the place.
brief_contract_fields.focal_priority: Ordered list of visual focal targets tied to spoken clauses in audio_lines.
brief_contract_fields.sound_perspective: Free-form acoustic point-of-view describing foreground foley, environmental bed (if any), J/L bridges, or intentional silence.
brief_contract_fields.restraint_note: Explicit boundaries on what must NOT be over-animated, cropped, or cluttered.

opening_hook.dramatic_goal: Arrest the viewer inside a concrete physical anomaly or human action in the first 15-25 seconds before opening the historical context.
opening_hook.visual_guidance: Start close on a human detail in cold fog or frost, then widen to reveal scale; split any still_25d over 5.0 s on spoken clause turns.
opening_hook.sound_guidance: Immediate physical foley (boots in frozen mud, breath, wind) under a restrained voiceover.

political_decision_vs_men_in_line.dramatic_goal: Expose the contrast between institutional decrees (Pope's failed appeal, commanders' orders) and the forgotten men shivering in the trenches (S02_SH008, S08_SH002).
political_decision_vs_men_in_line.visual_guidance: Keep the full huddled posture, boots, and heat source (brazier/candle) intact during the institutional setup, then push toward the soldier's face or hands on the human turn of the line.
political_decision_vs_men_in_line.sound_guidance: Raw freezing parapet wind and close fire crackle/breath dominate so the institutional words land against physical suffering.

tactical_map_and_sector_transition.dramatic_goal: Translate continental scale into human proximity (S02_SH001 -> S02_SH002 -> S02_SH003 -> S02_SH004).
tactical_map_and_sector_transition.visual_guidance: Lock route arrows and frontline traces to exact spoken words; connect consecutive maps of the same theater and bridge the final sector zoom into the trench scene.
tactical_map_and_sector_transition.sound_guidance: Every map action carries an explicit tactile sound decision; camera moves stay silent by design; add a J-cut human sound (such as a faint cough in freezing wind at the end of S02_SH003) when diving into the trench line.

sacred_or_tragic_tableau.dramatic_goal: Honour shared grief and solemnity without decorative clutter (S05_SH020 joint burial psalm).
sacred_or_tragic_tableau.visual_guidance: Move the camera calmly from the first spoken group (Scottish chaplain) to the second spoken group (German student) across the central crosses; forbid decorative glints or sparkles on crosses and coats.
sacred_or_tragic_tableau.sound_guidance: Hushed open snow air and absence of gunfire; let the spoken psalm and silence carry the emotional weight.
